source: Own measurement, 2026-11-19, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 1, 12 episodes, 2 per unit) with this build's grader: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) on the reference host (a shared 96-core x86-64 Linux server running other jobs, Docker), five ale validate runs run concurrently, 12 episodes each: validate-b91a56b3, validate-45fd4745, validate-979d10ac, validate-c14c44db and validate-ca421adf, mean_episode_credit 1.0 in each (the oracle's verification.json), so the mean over 60 episodes is 1.0. Every run: 12 of 12 episodes scored, no simulation faults, the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 595 of 595 differing, the same steps per episode in all five (4071-6552); the verify stage took 3532-3835 s for the 12 episodes.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json). full_at 0.98: the five runs showed no spread; one listed jar's refill half lost (0.25 of one episode, 0.021 of the metric) still leaves the reference at reward 1.0 after the engine's rounding.
